construction.evidence: Monthly 2026 series (2026-02-03 -> 2026-07-03, best frame 0.0% cloud): switchyard pad at CR12 x CR DD present throughout; NO array grading/racking anywhere on the Exhibit-1 tract through 2026-07-13. So the queue-reported constructionStart 2026-03-01 is NOT visible as array work - only the pre-existing switchyard (TCEQ stormwater active since Aug-2023/Jan-2024, EPC BayWa r.e.). Status: switchyard built, array not started. Corroboration: TNX Holdings lender page (archived 2026-07-22, sources/) says land SPV Sunset Energy Providers LLC held ~1,310 ac in Deaf Smith for Renegade, 'project substation has already been constructed on the site', land sold Oct-2025, financing/construction 'actively advancing' as of mid-2025.

cod.drift_reason: 11 COD slips over 6 years; IA original COD was 2022-06-01 (now 2027-12-16 = 5.5yr slip). EIA-860M (plant 65310 'Renegade Solar Project Dawn') reported 5 COD slips 2023-12→2024-12→2025-03→2025-06→2026-06→2026-12 and status='Not under construction' through 2026-05-01 — two months AFTER queue claims construction start 2026-03-01. EIA lag is 2+ months so actual construction status as of Jul 2026 unknown; EIA divergence upgrades risk to high. No PPA or financing close announced; site imagery not captured.
cod.eia_last_status: (T) Regulatory approvals received. Not under construction
